gs: GS1. read SOP, work instructions and instructions on equipment use
GS2. write reports and maintain records as per organization policy
GS3. practice active listening to capture task requirements from supervisor/ manager
GS4. communicate with colleagues in a polite, pleasant, calm and clear way
GS5. follow sequence of the work process as per SOP
GS6. check the application equipment to ensure it's proper working
GS7. deliver quality work as per agreed schedule

pcs.pc_description: receive work instructions, review and plan to meet the quality requirements
inspect the work area, assess hazards and risks and apply controls
check the work site for adequate ventilation and implement steps to prevent the formation of powder cloud, explosions and fires
check that the equipment and jigs/ hangers are suitable and ready for use
inspect the component condition visually
prepare and pre-treat the components as per SOP and instructions received
prepare components for re-coating by removing the defects and pre-treatment as per SOP
mask the areas not required to be coated with masking tapes, paper, plugs
implement measures to maintain coating area dust free
prepare the powder coating material for application by fluidizing the powder as per SOP
ensure that the powder is fluidized throughout the application process
set up the application and powder recovery system as per SOP and conduct pre-operational checks before actual coating
set up the recommended application parameters for the type of powder coating and application equipment
operate the application equipment as recommended by the equipment manufacturer and powder coating supplier
apply the coating to achieve the desired dry film thickness (DFT), colour, opacity and finish
cure/ dry the coating as per SOP
identify defects in the coating and take corrective measures to meet the quality requirements

modules.module_title: Maintain the equipment and jigs/ hangers

pcs.pc_description: clean up the work station and place the waste and discarded materials into appropriate waste bins or rubbish stock piles
clean the application booth and equipment as per SOP
store the application equipment safely
clean the jigs/ hangers as per SOP to ensure proper earthing of the components during application
filter the recovered powder coating before re-use
